title: Counterfactual Fairness Audits of Multi-Step Clinical LLM Agents Require a Measured Per-Action Instability Floor
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark for measuring demographic fairness (such as race, sex, age, and language proficiency) in multi-step clinical LLM agents. It explicitly states in the limitations that evaluating religion is out of scope, and it does not benchmark or evaluate moral or ethical reasoning.
